get.description: Detects whether insights can be generated for this date/period combination or not.
Generates insights for a set of reports. Plugins can add their own reports to be included in the insights overview by listening to the {@hook Insights.addReportToOverview} event.

get.description: Detects the movers and shakers for a set of reports. Plugins can add their own reports to be included in this overview by listening to the {@hook Insights.addReportToOverview} event.

get.description: Detects the movers and shakers of a given date / report combination. A mover and shakers has an higher impact than other rows on average. For instance if a sites pageviews increase by 10% a page that increased by 40% at the same time contributed significantly more to the success than the average of 10%.

parameters.name: reportUniqueId
parameters.description: eg 'Actions_getPageUrls'. An id like 'Goals_getVisitsUntilConversion_idGoal--4' works as well.

get.description: Generates insights by comparing the report for a given date/period with a different date and calculating the difference. The API can exclude rows which growth is not good enough or did not have enough impact.

parameters.name: reportUniqueId
parameters.description: eg 'Actions_getPageUrls'. An id like 'Goals_getVisitsUntilConversion_idGoal--4' works as well.

parameters.name: filterBy
parameters.description: By default all rows will be ignored. If given only 'movers', 'new' or 'disappeared' will be returned.

parameters.name: minImpactPercent
parameters.description: The minimum impact in percent. Eg '2%' of 1000 visits means the change / increase / decrease has to be at least 20 visits. Usually the '2%' are based on the total amount of visits but for reports having way less visits the metric total is used. Eg A page has 1000 visits but only 100 visits having keywords. In this case a minimum impact of '2%' evaluates to 2 and not 20.

parameters.name: minGrowthPercent
parameters.description: The amount of percent a row has to increase or decrease at least compared to the previous period. If value is '20' the growth has to be either at least '+20%' or '-20%' and lower.

parameters.name: comparedToXPeriods
parameters.description: The report will be compared to X periods before.
